# ARROW GOLF - Jay D. Mann - DREAMER 5 p.15 (PDF p.17)
# load 0080-03FF (printed range 0080-0400); CHIP-8 starts at 0200, run C000 FN 3
# how to play: 9 holes. Aim the arrow with the keys around 9 (4 up-left, 5 up, 6 up-right,
# 8 left, A right, C down-left, D down, E down-right); hold 9 to store power (beeps), on
# release the arrow travels a distance proportional to the beeps. Hitting a barrier bounces
# the arrow back and costs an extra stroke. Sink the putt by overlapping the square target.
# Each hole has extra random barriers; screen wrap-around can bypass them. Score: "Hole A = ..".
# Key remapping (enter as 0,key): up-left 023B, up 023F, up-right 0243, left 0233, right 0237,
# down-left 0227, down 022B, down-right 022F, power 02ED and 03D9.
# The author says the game "has a few patches"; no errata found in issues 5-19.
# The scan owner wrote by hand under row 00F0: 00F6 F00A 300F 10F6 00E0 1200 (wait for key F,
# erase, restart at 0200) and circled the end-of-game loop 133E at 033E. NOT applied here.
